description: Conditions MERIDIAN CORE is expected to produce. The detector strings below were taken from the console's own screens rather than guessed. Curating this per application is deliberate: what an application can legitimately say is domain knowledge, not something to rediscover per workflow.

outcomes.description: The operator session ended and the console asked for a fresh sign on.

result.message: The operator session timed out. Re-authenticate and invoke again.

outcomes.description: The console refused the operator id or password.

result.message: The console rejected those sign on credentials.

outcomes.description: The share being debited is on HOLD, so the transfer cannot proceed.

detector.value: is HOLD and cannot be debited

result.message: The source share is on hold and cannot be debited. Nothing was posted.

outcomes.description: The console rejected the transaction at the review screen.

detector.value: The transaction could not be validated

result.message: The console rejected the transaction at the review screen.

outcomes.description: The console rejected an injected or field-level validation request.

result.message: The console rejected the submitted field or transaction values.

outcomes.description: A restricted action was attempted by an operator who is not a supervisor.

detector.value: A supervisor must sign on to complete this request.

result.message: This action requires a supervisor. A human operator must decide how to proceed.

outcomes.description: The share does not hold enough to cover the amount.

result.message: The from-share does not have sufficient funds. Nothing was posted.

outcomes.description: The host returned its explicit RECORD NOT FOUND exceptional screen.

result.message: The requested member record could not be located.

outcomes.description: Nightly posting put the host into its known maintenance interstitial.

result.message: MERIDIAN CORE is temporarily in scheduled maintenance; retry later.

outcomes.description: The host returned its explicit hard application-error screen.

result.message: MERIDIAN CORE reported a hard application error.
